lede: The Planning Commission and Board of County Commissioners are sitting down together Thursday for a joint work session on proposed Land Use Code amendments covering forestry practices, oil and gas, deep geothermal operations, and condominium plats — no final votes, but this is where the shape of those changes gets worked out. Earlier in the week, the Open Space Commission takes up real decisions on Valley Floor trail alignments and a Telluride Mountain Club request to route a quarter-mile of trail through open space. The rest of the week is lighter on civic business but full of summer: a pie contest, Market on the Plaza, birding walks, and the 5th of July picnic in Town Park.

notable.stake: Commission chooses Valley Floor trail routes; Mountain Club access request decided.
Land Use Code rewrites covering forestry, oil, gas, geothermal, and condos take shape.
